about: The one construction of the Sylphx mark, wordmark and lockups (direction Engineered, chosen 2026-09-28; directions/README.md). logo/construction/mark.py draws every file in logo/ from this spec; change the spec and rerun, never edit an output by hand.

mark.about: Two currents that cross and weave into an x. Units are a 512 grid. Each current is a cubic S-curve stroked at stroke_width with flat ends; the rising current passes under the falling one, which is cut from it by a gap of weave_gap on each side.

colours.about: Mark colours. 'accent' draws the under current, 'ink' the over current; on dark grounds they become accent-on-dark and paper.

wordmark.about: Sylphx in IBM Plex Sans SemiBold with tight tracking.

lockup.about: Symbol beside the wordmark. The symbol's height is a multiple of the wordmark's cap height, centred on it; the gap is a fraction of the symbol height.

clear_space.about: Keep this much empty space around any version, as a fraction of the symbol height.

app_icon.about: Store and home-screen icons are full-bleed: the platform applies its own corner mask. The symbol sits inside the iOS and Android safe areas.
